atoms.text: Idioms sind Redewendungen im Englischen, die sowohl in der gesprochenen als auch der geschriebenen Sprache genutzt werden.
atoms.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Idioms</lang> sind Redewendungen im Englischen, die sowohl in der gesprochenen als auch der geschriebenen Sprache genutzt werden.

atoms.text: Es gibt eine Menge solcher Redewendungen. Hier ist eine Auswahl von häufig genutzten idioms:
atoms.sound: Es gibt eine Menge solcher Redewendungen. Hier ist eine Auswahl von häufig genutzten <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>idioms</lang>.

atoms.text:
to burn the midnight oil
bis spät (in die Nacht) arbeiten

example.a: “Where's Pete?”, Martha asked. “He must be burning the midnight oil again”, said Jerome, shrugging. “Again? His boss is really wearing him down!”, she sighed.
example.sound: Where's Pete?, Martha asked. He must be burning the midnight oil again, said Jerome, shrugging. Again? His boss is really wearing him down!, she sighed.

atoms.text:
to go the extra mile
sich besonders anstrengen

example.a: I am very proud of you! You really went the extra mile.
example.sound: I am very proud of you! You really went the extra mile.

atoms.text:
once in a blue moon
ganz selten, alle Jubeljahre

example.a: I only go on holidays once in a blue moon, I am too busy.
example.sound: I only go on holidays once in a blue moon, I am too busy.

atoms.text:
not my cup of tea
nicht mein Ding, nicht mein Fall

example.a: This kind of music is not my cup of tea.
example.sound: This kind of music is not my cup of tea.

atoms.text:
to be on the same page
auf derselben Wellenlänge sein

example.a: We get along very well! I think we are on the same page.
example.sound: We get along very well! I think we are on the same page.
example.b: to get along well: gut miteinander auskommen

atoms.text:
to get the show on the road
etw. in Gang bekommen, loslegen

example.a: I am ready now. Let's get the show on the road!
example.sound: I am ready now. Let's get the show on the road!

atoms.text:
to jump the gun
etw. überstürzen, voreilig handeln

example.a: Usually I don't like to jump the gun. I prefer to plan ahead.
example.sound: Usually I don't like to jump the gun. I prefer to plan ahead.

atoms.text:
the whole nine yards
das volle Programm

example.a: Tonight I went the whole nine yards by eating almost everything from the buffet.
example.sound: Tonight I went the whole nine yards by eating almost everything from the buffet.

atoms.text:
a leopard can’t change its spots
niemand kann aus seiner Haut heraus

example.a: I know that I am a bit annoying sometimes, but a leopard can’t change its spots.
example.sound: I know that I am a bit annoying sometimes, but a leopard can’t change its spots.

atoms.text:
Break a leg!
Hals- und Beinbruch! / Viel Glück!

example.a: You prepared yourself very well for the job interview tomorrow. Break a leg!
example.sound: You prepared yourself very well for the job interview tomorrow. Break a leg!

atoms.text:
to play it by ear
improvisieren, es darauf ankommen lassen

example.a: I don't feel prepared, so I have to play it by ear.
example.sound: I don't feel prepared, so I have to play it by ear.

atoms.text:
a piece of cake
kinderleicht, ein Kinderspiel

example.a: The last exam was a piece of cake.
example.sound: The last exam was a piece of cake.

atoms.text:
to bite the bullet
in den sauren Apfel beißen

example.a: He is not happy about cleaning his room today, but he has to bite the bullet.
example.sound: He is not happy about cleaning his room today, but he has to bite the bullet.

atoms.text:
Put your money where your mouth is!
Lass deinen Worten Taten folgen!

example.a: You promised not to tell anyone my secret, so I hope you put your money where your mouth is!
example.sound: You promised not to tell anyone my secret, so I hope you put your money where your mouth is!

atoms.text:
to chew the fat
schwatzen, über Gott und die Welt reden

example.a: I can always chew the fat with her.
example.sound: I can always chew the fat with her.
